assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent character sprite for the existing Japanese preschool cooking app. Image 1 is the official approved UI and edit target. Extract ONLY the exact boy chef on the left, holding the wooden spoon and waving. Keep his facial identity, black straight fringe, slightly narrow eyes, natural open smiling mouth with visible upper teeth, proportions, expression, pose, white chef hat, white shirt, yellow apron and green leaf exactly as shown. This is a faithful extraction, NOT a character redesign. Complete the small bottom edge of the apron that meets the countertop into a natural clean waist-up cutout. Preserve both hands and spoon, full hat, soft painterly children's picture-book texture. Remove ALL kitchen background, table, UI, text, cards, food, white speech clouds, yellow emphasis marks. True transparent background. Character alone centered, fills about 90% height, with comfortable clear margin all around, portrait composition. Do not change the face to round cartoon eyes, do not add objects or text.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one transparent sprite atlas for a children's cooking game, matching Image 1 official UI exactly. Reproduce the SIX food illustrations from the six bottom selection cards as independent illustrated sprites, without their card backgrounds or labels. Arrange in a strict 3 columns by 2 rows grid of equal square cells on a landscape 3:2 canvas. Each sprite centered in its own cell with at least 12% transparent padding and no sprite crossing cell boundaries. Reading order: top left the smiling triangular white onigiri with black nori rectangle and pink cheeks; top center golden yellow sliced rolled Japanese omelet showing spiral layers; top right cluster of three golden crispy karaage pieces; bottom left green broccoli floret; bottom center round red cherry tomato with green calyx; bottom right orange five-petal flower-shaped carrot slice. Match the official reference's food forms, colors, soft textured flat picture-book illustration and subtle highlights. The six food items are the only visible content. Genuine transparent background; no plate, no cards, no lettering, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows outside the food. Bright appetizing large simple forms suitable for ages 3–6. Do not add a face to anything except the onigiri.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent cake base game layer. Image 1 is approved home UI cake and Image 2 is the approved illustration style. The top must be plain bare light golden sponge with no cream or toppings so the child can paint cream and decorate it interactively. Keep the top a simple unobstructed ellipse centered horizontally. The top ellipse spans about x=12% to88%, y=15% to71% of a landscape8:5 canvas; cake side down to90%, blue plate down to97%. Transparent background everywhere outside cake and plate, no ambient glow, no vignette, no backdrop, no cast shadow, no letters, no character. Soft textured flat illustration, bold vivid appetizing colors, subtle highlights matching official UI, not photorealistic.

Keep the exact original perspective, gentle painterly flat children's picture-book style and palette. No people, no faces, no food, no text, no UI shapes.
